Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.model.GameModel
public class GameModel extends Object
Holds the complete client-side projection of an ongoing game session.

Each update* method corresponds to a specific server notification. The method applies the delta to the local state and then fans out the update to all registered ClientView observers, which may include both the GUI and the TUI simultaneously.

All public methods are synchronized on the model's own monitor, so views running on different threads can safely read state at any time.
